<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **15** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 172b4cf30c4aab44608cf689176f44be0aacbe74` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8b2e8a33a1f2be7ff5133dd1cb193cca0da71491`

### ① Derived judgments

- **Docstring truth (`404 \`NO_DRAFT\` when there is nothing to publish`)** — CORRECT. Producer: `SysMetadataRepository.promoteDraft`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts:942-948` on `origin/main`, throws `Error('No pending draft exists for ${type}/${name} — nothing to publish.')` with `err.code = 'NO_DRAFT'`, `err.status = 404`, no bracketed opener; `git log -S'[no_draft]'` on that file names `7a25a3ee9` (PR #19683, merged 2026-09-22) as the commit that turned `[no_draft] No pending draft…` into `No pending draft…`. REST: the `POST ${metaPath}/:type/:name/publish` handler (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:8428-8590`) catches into `handleRouteError` (`packages/rest/src/error-response.ts:2703`) → `resolveErrorResponse` declared-status passthrough → `res.status(404).json({ error: msg, code: 'NO_DRAFT' })`, pinned byte-for-byte in `packages/rest/src/rest-4xx-message-truncation.test.ts:344-352` and `rest-expected-error-logging.test.ts:127`; `NO_DRAFT` is a ledger member (`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts:614`) so it is never demoted to `declaredCode`. SDK: `ObjectStackClient.fetch` (`packages/client/src/index.ts:7307-7395`) rejects on `!res.ok` with an `Error` whose `.message` is the server's `error` string, `.code = 'NO_DRAFT'`, `.httpStatus = 404` (`unwrapResponse` is never reached). Status, code axis and message all match the corrected line.
- **Changeset prose facts** — CORRECT on every claim: "ships into `dist/index.d.ts`" is measured independently of the dev's build — the published npm tarball `@objectstack/client@17.4.0` carries the old sentence at `dist/index.d.ts:1594` (`404 [no_draft] when there is nothing to publish. [#12195] The name is …`), and `packages/client/package.json` publishes `files: ['dist','README.md','CHANGELOG.md']`, `types: dist/index.d.ts`; "no behaviour change" — the source diff is one comment line; "since PR #19683 (#16245)" — that PR's diff is the removal at this exact producer; "that PR removed from the message" — true (`git show 7a25a3ee9 -- …sys-metadata-repository.ts`).
- **Changeset markdown** — WRONG. The body spells the corrected token as `` `404 \`NO_DRAFT\`` ``; CommonMark does not honour backslash escapes inside a code span, so the first span closes at the escaped backtick. GitHub's own renderer (the `body_html` of the PR body, which carries the identical string) and a CommonMark renderer run in scratch over `.changeset/19704-client-no-draft-jsdoc.md` both produce: a code span holding only `404 \`, then plain text `NO_DRAFT``, then `on the` as a code span, `code` as plain text, then `axis, instead of the retired bracketed lowercase opener` as a code span, then plain `[no_draft]``. `@changesets/cli/changelog` copies this body verbatim into `packages/client/CHANGELOG.md` (RELEASE-OWNED, ships in the npm tarball — "the text an upgrading agent greps", and a post-release correction costs a dedicated docs-only PR per AGENTS.md). The one sentence the changeset exists to deliver renders garbled. The sibling `.changeset/16245-bracketed-tag-refusal-openers.md` shows the working spellings: a plain `` `NO_DRAFT` `` span, and a double-backtick span for nesting.
- **Backtick vs bracket notation** — the PR's spelling is CORRECT and is the repo convention, not a novelty: the spec's own describe text reads `'404 \`NO_DRAFT\` when there is nothing to publish; …'` (`packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts:898`) and `'answers 404 \`NO_DRAFT\`'` (`protocol.zod.ts:820`); across `packages/*/src` non-test sources there are 79 `NNN \`CODE\`` sites versus 3 `NNN [CODE]` sites, and all 3 bracket sites are in this same client file (`index.ts:6227`, `:6278` `400 [VALIDATION_FAILED]`, `:6297` `404 [RULE_NOT_FOUND]`), while the same file already uses backticks at `:4833` (`409 \`PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET\``). The inconsistency is pre-existing and more than a nit for those 3 lines: `404 [RULE_NOT_FOUND]` is exactly the shape the #16245 ruling retired from messages, so a reader or AI takes it as "the message opens with `[RULE_NOT_FOUND]`", which no producer emits (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts:818` throws a bare `Error('RULE_NOT_FOUND')`), and ADR-0112's own table names a contract docstring as what "teaches the old spelling to the next author (and to AI)". Outside this card's file-surface and spelling claim; correctly reported, not fixed, here.
- **Dropping `[#12195]`** — SOUND. `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12195` answers 404 (neither issue nor PR) and a board search for "12195" returns nothing; `scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` (diff-scoped by design; package docblocks and `.changeset/**` are declared surfaces) reddened the prior head `053c6ec7` on exactly this line — job 108569681412, step "Issue citations this change adds resolve on the board" — as `allocated-but-absent`. A phantom tracker number in a published `.d.ts` is provenance no consumer can follow; the sentence's substance (percent-encoded name, retired compound arity) is kept and its history survives in `packages/client/CHANGELOG.md` ("Two SDK doc comments that promised 'compound names pass through unencoded' (`meta.getPublished`, `meta.publishItem`) are corrected"). Three other `[#12195]` citations remain in untouched lines of the same file (tarball `dist/index.d.ts:581`, `:625`, `:1508`) — outside the gate's diff scope and the card, consistent with the gate header's "standing sites are census, not verdict". `#7294` in the same docblock resolves (closed issue).

### ② Semver level

`patch` is the right level. The change publishes (the docstring is in the tarball's `dist/index.d.ts`), so AGENTS.md Post-Task #3 forbids `skip-changeset`; nothing on the wire, in the request, or in the return type moves, so `Clause-②: no` holds and `minor` is not owed; `@objectstack/client` is in the `fixed` lockstep group, where `patch` is the floor for the group bump. Precedent in `packages/client/CHANGELOG.md` entry `1bb5a56` ("JSDoc/`.d.ts` wording only") shipped at the same level. A patch changeset lacking a `Clause-②` line matches sibling patch changesets (`12271`, `13272`, `14361`); the ADR-0087 gate reads that line only for a breaking arm.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **CI on the head at read time**: 31 check-runs — 20 success, 3 skipped, 8 still `in_progress` (Lint & Repo Gates with its "Issue citations…" step still pending, Type Check · workspace, Test Core 1/2/3/6, Dogfood 2/3); no failure; combined status `success`; PR `mergeable: true`, `mergeable_state: blocked` (draft, unreviewed). Prior head `053c6ec7` failed only that citation step; the head removed its cause. Not green yet; landing waits on the remaining 8.
- **PR title misnames the method**: "promoteItem JSDoc …" — `git grep -i promoteItem origin/main` finds nothing anywhere in the tree; the method is `meta.publishItem`. The repo squash-merges with `squash_merge_commit_title: PR_TITLE`, so this false name becomes the commit subject on `main` (the round-0 commit `053c6ec7` carries the same "promoteItem/publishItem" subject).
- **PR body date error**: "that PR landed on 2026-08-29 (`7a25a3ee9c`)" — the commit is dated 2026-09-22 12:50 UTC and PR #19683 merged 2026-09-22T13:11:59Z; 2026-08-29 is the maintainer ruling date. Prose only, not in the diff.
- **Two class-(b) findings noted, none filed**: `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:8427` route comment `404 [no_draft]` (source-only) and `packages/client/src/index.ts:6297` `404 [RULE_NOT_FOUND]` (published — tarball `dist/index.d.ts:4027`). Prime Directive #10 wants a published-declaration-vs-runtime disagreement filed as a card, not left to a round report; no card for either was found on the board.
- **No other live carrier of the retired spelling**: the remaining `[no_draft]` hits on `origin/main` are pre-fix narration in test comments, self-constructed fixtures in `packages/rest` tests, a dated revision note in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json:1876`, and the #16245 changeset — none a present-tense claim; `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` was regenerated by the #16245 round.
- **Branch base**: head is 2 commits on `455dcc060`; `origin/main` has moved to `560b724c9`; GitHub reports `mergeable: true`, and the file surface is disjoint from what landed.
- **Draft state**: the PR is still `draft: true` with no review; the relay forced it.

**VERDICT: FAIL**
- `.changeset/19704-client-no-draft-jsdoc.md`: replace the malformed code span `` `404 \`NO_DRAFT\`` `` with a spelling CommonMark renders — plain ``404 `NO_DRAFT` `` (no nesting), or a double-backtick span around the whole `404 \`NO_DRAFT\`` — so the shipped `CHANGELOG.md` entry reads the token it exists to deliver.
- Retitle the PR to name `publishItem` (the squash-merge subject is the PR title; `promoteItem` exists nowhere in the tree).

## Contract review Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` Head-sha: `ab7a61340de3219805339725efd5b61449be8b21` Delta of: `5853960447` (FAIL on `8b2e8a33`) ### ① Derived judgments - **Required change 1 — changeset code span** — MET. Delta `git diff 8b2e8a33 ab7a6134` is one line of `.changeset/19704-client-no-draft-jsdoc.md`: `` `404 \`NO_DRAFT\`` `` → ``404 `NO_DRAFT` `` (front matter `'@objectstack/client': patch` untouched). Mechanical CommonMark pairing (a run of N backticks closes at the next run of exactly N; backslash is not an escape inside a span) over the head body yields exactly five spans: `publishItem`, `dist/index.d.ts`, `NO_DRAFT`, `code`, `[no_draft]`, with `404 ` as plain text before `NO_DRAFT`. GitHub's own renderer (GET `/contents/.changeset/19704-client-no-draft-jsdoc.md?ref=ab7a6134`, `Accept: application/vnd.github.html`) produces the same five `` spans and the fragment `404 NO_DRAFT on the code axis`. Tree-wide `[no_draft]` (excluding releases/CHANGELOGs): the only `packages/client` hit is `:2152`; 0 hits in `packages/client` test files. #19705 closed `completed` 2026-09-24 via PR #19843, whose file list is exactly `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`.
